explication: yoinks is a terminal video downloader. The user launches the CLI with a URL or enters one in the full-screen interface, reviews extracted video information and available resolutions or audio-only output, chooses a format, and downloads the file to ~/Downloads. The app orchestrates probing, format selection, progress, and completion through yt-dlp, with ffmpeg available for merging and audio extraction; it also records URL history. The graph preserves the documented terminal UI, theme, and mouse features. Some links are based on README statements or source-index references because implementation excerpts are incomplete.
